_comment: Company-wide managed settings for Claude Code. Deploy to /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json (macOS) or %ProgramData%\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json (Windows) via MDM. Workforce members cannot override these locally.

env._comment_baa: Set ANTHROPIC_BAA_SIGNED=true ONLY after the BAA is countersigned and on file with the Privacy Officer. Toggling this enables billing-audit and any other plugin gated on real PHI.
env._comment_actor: Set per-user via MDM-injected user-scoped env so audit attribution is correct. Falls back to git user.email if unset.

_audit_note: All Claude Code activity is exported via OpenTelemetry to the SIEM. Logs retained 6 years per HIPAA Security Rule §164.316(b)(2)(i).
